approvalPolicy: Only curated references may influence generation.

learn: Use LayoutGroup for dynamic repeated content.
Pair ScrollRect content with Mask or RectMask2D viewports.

holdouts.reason: Specialized motion and effects require manual review.

rules: Keep asset pixel size, layout target size, RectTransform size, and Sprite Border separate.
A dimension mismatch is never a failure by itself.
Do not use negative scale on text or semantic containers without explicit evidence.
Use LayoutGroup for dynamic content; fixed decoration may keep explicit positions.
